text:
Ana: FYI - SkyScale changed their marketplace SKU naming again and our reserved allocation for `ss-resv-77` in eu-central is unresolved. We need 12x A100-ish for the SI integration demo on Fri 08:00 UTC for a 24h window. Can procurement/status please?

supply-bot: marketplace-sync: ALIAS_MISMATCH for ss-resv-77
```
code: ALIAS_UNMAPPED
old_sku: SKY-A100-v1
new_sku: SKY-A100-XL
reservation: ss-resv-77
```

Marco: Vendor announced inventory consolidation; lead-time bumped 2d -> 12d. We have 8 units in our Dedicated pool in eu-central, and 4 in partner-managed racks (requires marketplace delegation). Short options: (A) move 4 from dev cluster (CI hit) (B) request emergency partner hold (+premium) (C) scale demo to 8 and simulate load.

Jules: Demo is customer-facing with SI present, so they want full 12. Press coverage might follow. Legal: anything blocking emergency partner hold?

LegalBot: Short-term partner holds require a signed short SOW. We can inline-authorize a one-off addendum under existing MSA if finance approves the fee. ETA legal review 45m.

Ana: Timebox: we need decision in 30m. If we go partner-hold, finance signoff needed now. Marco, can you quantify premium?

Marco: Emergency hold quote = +40% and non-refundable. Partner can ship 4 nodes as partial in ~5 days, not in time for Fri. Only reallocation from internal dev gives immediate availability.

Jules: If we pull from dev we break nightly CI. Can we borrow 4 for 24h and return? Impact: delayed tests and a roll window risk. Ops?

Marco: Ops can temporarily cordon 4 nodes from dev cluster and mark them as reserve; will require a brief maintenance window to drain jobs (~2h). I can do that tonight.

Ana: That seems fastest. Action: Marco to cordon 4 nodes, supply-bot to retry alias mapping after we update mapping for SKY-A100-XL to internal alias `sky-a100-xl-2026`. Jules to prep scaled-8 backup deck and PR note. Legal will expedite SOW in parallel if partner hold still needed.

supply-bot: Alias mapping attempt: PENDING. Waiting for manual confirm to map SKY-A100-XL -> sky-a100-xl-2026

Marco: Cordon scheduled 21:00 UTC tonight. Will tag @oncall-eng for drains.

LegalBot: Draft addendum prepared and sent to finance for emergency approval.

Ana: Thanks. If mapping resolves and cordon succeeds we proceed with full 12. If mapping flips again we fall back to scaled 8 demo. Keep updates here. :eyes:
